rule: A swap of two neighbouring statements is judged observable when (1) a hook or port call reads state the other statement writes, (2) a refusal (require, or a method that calls it) can end the call between them and the state left differs, (3) a callback run inside a call reads a name the other statement binds, or (4) a value is read before or after a state change it depends on. Exceptions the mission does not model (constructors and queries on well-formed planner output) and dict key order alone are not counted. The 12 swaps judged observable (one more after Codex round 5: a refused realignment install leaves the new follower unrun) got behaviour tests (batch 11 and B8); these are the rest.
